_comment: THE nightly rotation (GH #360). Which Macs run the nightly, and when. Read by scripts/install_nightly.sh (the launchd time), scripts/nightly_guarded.sh (an off-rota Mac never runs), tools/publish_metrics.py (an off-rota Mac's rows leave the pass/fail table; the page shows it as 'off the rotation', never as a failure) and scripts/morning_metrics.sh. Labels are the short host labels (RicksM4 -> M4). "analysis" is the Swift 6 analysis lane's slot (scripts/install_analysis_lane.sh; the away window) and "sanitizer" says which sanitizer kind that lane runs on which weekday (`--sanitizer auto`; the two kinds cannot share a build or a night). "gauntlet" lists the Macs whose run is the FULL testbed: the nightly suite, then the deep gauntlet, both published, then one done line and a notification on Rick's Mac (scripts/nightly_gauntlet.sh). The M4 runs at 14:00 for a midday read on main; the M5 Ultra keeps 02:00 (Rick, 2026-11-05).

off.M1: MacBook Pro, travel laptop, often on battery: out of the nightly (Rick, GH #360, 2026-10-21)
off.M5: MacBook Pro: a closed lid sleeps it all night whatever caffeinate holds (10/22: 37 sleeps 03:00-10:00); laptops are not nightly hosts (Rick, 2026-10-22). Mac Studios only: the M4, plus the M5 Ultra from the week of 10/27
